title: Industrial Designer, Intern
note: Home robotics startup; open to current Industrial Design students and recent grads.

facts.duties: Design new home robot products through sketching, CAD and rendering; build 3D models and physical prototypes; support CMF work; refine details with engineers.
facts.requirements: Current or recent Industrial Design degree; portfolio; 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred); sketching, rendering and prototyping skills.
facts.apply: Apply online through the 'Apply for this role' link on Weave's careers page.
